scope: Local native source behavioral tests and bounded old-target queued-stop regression demonstration.

environment.interpreterProvisioning: Disposable environment built by the native package manager; no shared environment or installed product modified.
environment.hermesHome: The wrapper command creates and passes a distinct mktemp HERMES_HOME, but scripts/run_tests.sh drops that caller variable through env -i; it is not inherited by pytest. Native tests/conftest.py establishes an isolated per-process Hermes home before test-module imports, and per-test fixtures establish fresh temporary profiles, including the explicit profiles in these two test files.
environment.sandboxReason: Parent independently verified default sandbox blocks asyncio thread-safe socket wakeups; the same minimal reproducer completes in the authorized escalated environment.
environment.runnerGitDiagnostic: The exported mirror has no .git metadata; official bytecode preparation prints a nonfatal git diagnostic and the test runner continues.
environment.sqlitePolicy: Native SQLite compatibility policy remains enabled; the linked 3.45.1 interpreter uses DELETE journal mode as reported in the baseline log.

sourceBindingLimit: These hashes identify the two test files and two directly relevant native modules; the parent packet separately owns complete source closure and publication provenance.

finalRun.command:
set -o pipefail
r159_test_home=$(mktemp -d /tmp/r159-lifecycle-home.XXXXXX)
HERMES_PYTHON=/tmp/r159-native-test-env/bin/python HERMES_HOME="$r159_test_home" HERMES_TEST_FILE_RETRIES=0 bash scripts/run_tests.sh -j 1 --file-timeout 90 tests/gateway/test_api_server_borrowed_transport.py tests/gateway/test_api_server_queued_stop_retirement.py --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tee /tmp/r159-lifecycle-final-run.log

lastNarrowReviewFix.finding: A retained native session subscription was not included in the listener retirement preflight, although the later runtime retirement checked it.
lastNarrowReviewFix.change: Reuse native _sessions_idle before the transport enters RETIRING or closes the listener.
lastNarrowReviewFix.behavior: Actual authority.attach on a terminal native API admission blocks retirement with no active HTTP handlers; listener remains serving and authenticated GET succeeds. Actual authority.detach then permits the full ordered native close.

baselineRegression.command:
set -o pipefail
r159_test_home=$(mktemp -d /tmp/r159-queued-baseline-home.XXXXXX)
HERMES_PYTHON=/tmp/r159-native-test-env/bin/python HERMES_HOME="$r159_test_home" HERMES_TEST_FILE_RETRIES=0 bash scripts/run_tests.sh -j 1 --file-timeout 90 tests/gateway/test_api_server_queued_stop_retirement.py -k 'test_queued_stop_after_producer_retirement_leaves_no_live_marker or test_unobserved_queued_stop_during_drain_remains_terminal_and_idempotent' --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tee /tmp/r159-queued-baseline-red.log
baselineRegression.supportingGeneration: The isolated copy uses current R159 supporting code and the current queued-stop test file; only api_server_authority_runs.py is restored to exact d151 bytes.

selectedTests.name: test_queued_stop_after_producer_retirement_leaves_no_live_marker
selectedTests.behavior: Actual canonical queued cancellation settles the producer while native media cleanup is held in a physical worker; the old Stop path re-adds a live marker after producer retirement.

selectedTests.name: test_unobserved_queued_stop_during_drain_remains_terminal_and_idempotent
selectedTests.behavior: Actual unobserved queued cancellation during drain leaves an unretirable stop marker under the old target.

coverage: Actual profile ownership, original epoch, three caller-owned SQLite stores, native prepared GatewayRunner and API adapter.
Literal loopback binding, narrow authenticated routes, duplicate/room/query-only authorization refusal, ordinary borrowed listener rejection.
Original identity and phase checks, including off-loop native _execute_write while the actual SQLite transaction is open.
Drain seals new admission but retains real queued observation and Stop; started Stop targets the original claimed generation and does not claim terminal.
Actual outer HTTP task cancellation retains a shielded inner handler and its physical to_thread SQL worker until completion.
Native _UnboundedThreadExecutor physical worker blocks retirement even after the dispatcher task returns.
Actual native observer attach/detach blocks listener retirement until its obligation is released.
Cancelled setup, occupied bind, cancelled inner handler and lost cleanup acknowledgement retain UNKNOWN ownership without product retries.
Idle HTTP keepalive connection does not deadlock ordered listener retirement.
Borrowed metrics do not start the ordinary unowned status writer.
Prepared home/secret/terminal request scopes use captured copies and perform no per-request secret hydration.
Canonical queued cancellation proof requires current epoch/instance, NULL generation and absence of the exact managed worker; stale epoch, contradictory worker and started claim suppress proof.

failedRunHistory.reason: The nominally pure guard read facade._db, whose property reentered the native state lock during a real off-loop write transaction. A separate test tried to monkeypatch a slot-based SockSite instance method.
failedRunHistory.resolution: Native guard checks the captured original raw gate/state/connection/lock identity without invoking the locking property. The test patches the SockSite class and verifies the exact owned instance.

failedRunHistory.reason: A queued canonical ledger row made transport retirement raise BorrowedRunnerRejected instead of the public BorrowedStoreRejected busy refusal; host close would have classified this as UNKNOWN.
failedRunHistory.resolution: Normalize only BorrowedRunnerRejected in transport pre-effect idle checks, preserving the reason and READY/DRAINING phase; awaited or partial cleanup failures are not converted.

limits: Tests use local source exports and temporary profiles; they do not install or qualify the daily service, service supervisor or packaged runtime.
Provider/model execution is not exercised. The started-stop fixture uses a real canonical claim with a local interrupt observer.
Fixture disposal after deliberately UNKNOWN cases is test-only cleanup and is not a successful product close receipt.
The old-target red check uses mixed supporting generations and proves only the two selected queued-stop regressions.
